summary: Frontend-only P0 batch verified on iPhone viewport (414x900). All four feature areas pass: (1) 7th 'Walk to the Ḥaram' tile added to Home below the 2x3 grid, original 6 tiles intact; (2) /walk-haram page renders with correct title, auto-locates, gracefully shows error UI when preview iframe blocks GPS, Try again + Use phone maps buttons work, external-maps opens google.com/maps with travelmode=walking, Back returns to /; (3) Lost page: old green 'satnav-haram-btn' REMOVED, red 'locate-btn' still primary, new error card with lost-retry replaces old banner; (4) Settings: old toggle removed, new segmented control with settings-prayer-mode-auto + settings-prayer-mode-makkah both clickable, persists umrah_prayer_mode='auto'/'makkah' to localStorage, active button has white pill background, descriptive copy flips between 'auto-detect your city using GPS' and 'follow Makkah, wherever you are'. Backend /api/gates/nearest verified via curl with POST {lat:21.42,lng:39.83} returning Bab al-Safa, distance 0.383 km. Success 100% on 33/33 assertions.
critical_code_review_comments: WalkHaram.jsx and Lost.jsx duplicate openExternalMaps() logic and the geolocation-error handling block (~30 lines). Consider extracting into the existing lib/locationErrors.js or a new lib/externalMaps.js to satisfy DRY.

Home.jsx has grown to 1000+ lines (exceeds 700-line guideline). DailyReminderCard, PrayerTimesCard, QuickTile should be extracted into /components. Not blocking, but worth flagging for maintainability.
